name: contentos
description: ContentOS — B2B LinkedIn image content operating system

scripts.install:api: cd apps/api && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -U pip setuptools wheel && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'
scripts.install:infra: cd infra && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.synth:dev: npm run build:layer && cd infra && ./scripts/deploy.sh dev synth
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:layer && cd infra && ./scripts/deploy.sh dev deploy
scripts.deploy:qa: npm run build:layer && cd infra && ./scripts/deploy.sh qa deploy
